interpretation: Negative correlation between reconstructed nearest-gNB distance and the dataset's own recorded downlink SINR would support the nearest-gNB-by-distance heuristic as a reasonable serving-cell reconstruction (closer -> stronger signal, matching real path-loss physics). The dataset only records SINR for the UE's one actual serving cell, not per-candidate-gNB, so a true SINR-based reassignment rule (picking the gNB with the best SINR among all candidates) cannot be computed from this data — that would require re-simulating with per-candidate-cell measurements.
